Hi! I’m Claude Code — here to help with your repo or any engineering tasks.

What would you like to do first?
- Explore this repo and summarize its structure
- Run tests/build and inspect failures
- Fix a specific bug or implement a feature
- Do a quick code review or refactor

If you want me to scan the repo and summarize it, say “explore the repo.” If you prefer to run a command yourself, prefix it with “!”, e.g., “! git status”.
